title: Your towers ARE the maze.
note: Hand-built maze (capture --map, seed 4242, obstacles edge): three staggered Thornwall walls alternating bottom/top/bottom, a cap over the glade, an east wall and a sill so the route reaches the Heartwood from the side; Sporelings on the bends. 50 Wardens, route ~18 -> 62 cells. screenshot_01 uses the same spots in the same order.
captions: Every Warden bends the path the nightmares walk.
Fifty Wardens in: three times the path.
Then I hit start. They walk every bend of it.
